domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 扣件支承与连接功能丧失或退化的状态。
usage_overview: 作为动力分析中的损伤状态，用于研究钢轨与下部支承连接功能退化对车辆—轨道相互作用的影响。一种模拟方式是将失效扣件的刚度和阻尼同时置零，表示其支承与连接作用的丧失。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: The numerical results show that rail fastener failure has a great influence on both the wheel/rail interactions and the track vibrations if the number of rail fastener failure is over three.

Therefore, this present work will put more perspectives on how to capture the full view of dynamic behaviours of railway vehicle-track systems when jointly accounting for the effects of rail fastener failure and track random irregularities.
